purpose: Teach: 書き手/読み上げ/意気込み/組み合わせる/梱包/別紙/試料/春休み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の書き手、皆、手書きだった。
lines.en: The old writers—they all wrote by hand.
lines.style: Reflective, drawing on a memory with gentle patience. Slow, deliberate pacing. Let the thought settle. No rush to move forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。式典の社訓読み上げ、伝統で続けてます。
lines.en: Yes. We continue the tradition of reading the company creed at our ceremonies.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Measured delivery, showing he takes this seriously. A slight nod in the voice—not stiff, but formally present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の意気込み、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't forget the spirit they had when they founded this place.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Weight on the opening word. Short, direct sentences. The voice of someone who has seen what gets lost and what endures.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。若手と熟練、組み合わせる体制、強化しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've strengthened how we pair newer staff with experienced ones.
lines.style: Clear, confident report. Steady pace. The tone of someone presenting concrete steps taken, not just intentions. Slightly formal but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 梱包の質、ブランドの一部だ。
lines.en: The quality of your packaging—it's part of the brand itself.
lines.style: Declarative, almost aphoristic. Slight emphasis on 'brand.' A pause before saying it, as if establishing a principle that won't be debated.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。資料、別紙でも、確認頂けます。
lines.en: Yes. You can review the materials in the attached documents.
lines.style: Efficient and respectful. Practical tone—offering proof, not argument. Calm, organized delivery, showing readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 試料に勝る経験はない。
lines.en: There's no teacher like handling the thing itself.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Speaks from experience earned over decades. Slight pause before the second clause, letting it land as wisdom, not lecture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。春休みは、新人と過ごす時間、設けます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we spend time with the new hires during spring break.
lines.style: Warm closing commitment. The pace softens slightly—less formal now, more personal resolve. As if saying: I heard you, and I'm making it happen.
